headline: Zorana Jovanovic Andersen: ERS leaves COP31 calling for urgent fossil fuel phase-out for lung health
dek: The European Respiratory Society's Advocacy Council chair said the society went to Antalya urging that health be placed at the heart of climate action.
body:
Zorana Jovanovic Andersen, Chair of the Advocacy Council at the European Respiratory Society (ERS) and Professor of Environmental Epidemiology at the University of Copenhagen, has set out the society's key message from COP31 Türkiye. Writing on LinkedIn, she said countries had failed to agree on including fossil fuels and a transition away from them in the proposed 'Antalya Pact'.

She said ERS came to Antalya with a clear message to put health at the heart of climate action, and leaves with one key call: an urgent fossil fuel phase-out for lung health. According to Jovanovic Andersen, phasing out fossil fuels would address some of the most harmful sources of air pollution and bring cleaner air, with immediate benefits for people living with asthma and other respiratory diseases. She said it would also help prevent future cases and reduce inequalities in lung health.

She also wrote that a phase-out is essential to slow climate change and to limit the magnitude and duration of a pending 1.5°C overshoot. In her words, every fraction of a degree of warming avoided would protect respiratory health by reducing exposure to extreme heat, wildfire smoke, dust storms and other climate-related hazards.

Jovanovic Andersen pointed to an upcoming World Health Organization report on the health effects of black carbon. She described black carbon as a potent air pollutant produced by the incomplete combustion of fossil fuels and a powerful short-lived climate forcer, associated with significant health impacts on all major lung, heart and brain diseases. She said the new evidence strengthens the case for a phase-out as a shared priority across the climate, air pollution and health agendas.

She thanked contributors to panel discussions on these topics at the World Health Organization Health Pavilion at COP31 Türkiye.
key_quote: There can be no healthy lungs on an unhealthy planet.
